mentions.name: Star Trek Enterprise journey visualization
mentions.description: A visualization site that dynamically traces the path the Enterprise took across several Star Trek series, built from Memory Alpha, episode scripts, and Star Charts data; many locations are inferred due to storytelling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been pulling a bunch of stuff from Memory Alpha, Scripts, and the Star Charts, and have a reasonably interesting visualization of a few series.
mentions.author: dvd42
